function: above_phy (pp. 6, 8): the DRL policy (EPPO) only outputs the flight displacement (trajectory) of the UAV carrying the IRS; IRS phase shifts come from a closed-form rule (Eq. 15), not learned.
notes: Excluded as above_phy. p. 6: "the action of agent at is represented as at = {axt, ayt, azt}, where axt, ayt and azt are the flight distance of UAV". p. 8: the phase shifts are calculated "using Eq. (15). Specifically, the original action space of (Mr x Mc + 3) is reduced to 3." p. 9: the SU runs EPPO "to control the movement of the UAV-carried IRS" while an FPGA sets the phases by Eq. (15). p. 10: "the benchmark algorithms need to learn IRS phase shifts, EPPO does not". So the learned decision is the UAV trajectory, which code 4 lists as above the physical layer, and the physical-layer decision (IRS phases) is closed-form, so the joint exception does not apply. Reviewer check: read literally, no_learning (code 3) could also fit, since learned phases appear only in the DRL baselines; I chose above_phy because the proposed method itself is learned. Single-antenna SU and users with a UAV-carried IRS at mmWave, Rician channel (p. 4).
